method: Manual translation/review of all displayed lesson and assessment strings. Previously reviewed b/m/a/e lessons retained; c/t lessons manually translated from French in the final batch. French source, answer indices and choice order unchanged.

semanticChecks: Correct-choice positions checked for all 24 questions against the French source.
Preserved negation: no current does not mean no voltage; fault clearance does not restart the latch; an RCD switch alone does not protect against overload.
Distinguished RMS/average/peak, active/reactive/apparent power, register raw values/scales, and resolution/accuracy.
Retained the ideal-model assumptions for RC, transformer, bridge and buck converter.

Checked numerical examples: 4 mA and 8 V divider; balanced 1000 Ω bridge leg; RC tau 1 s; transformer 12 V from 24 V; AC 48 VA and 24 W; rectified averages 6.37 V and 7.07 V; loop 12 mA=5 bar and 16 mA=7.5 bar; 253*0.1=25.3 °C; 12 bits=4096 codes; PWM output 6 V.
